name: LangSmith
tagline: LLM application observability, tracing, evaluation, and prompt engineering platform.
definition: LangSmith is a developer platform for building, testing, debugging, and monitoring LLM applications. It provides full execution chain tracing, prompt evaluation frameworks, latent error analysis, and dataset testing for complex agentic workflows.
why_it_matters: Debugging non-deterministic LLM chains and autonomous agents without tracing is notoriously difficult. LangSmith provides visibility into every prompt execution, token cost, latency bottleneck, and agent step across production AI applications.
workplace_use_cases: Tracing multi-step LLM agent executions to pinpoint exact tool call failures
Evaluating prompt engineering iterations against curated golden benchmark datasets
Monitoring token consumption costs and API latency metrics across production deployments
Debugging retrieval augmented generation (RAG) context recall failures
how_to_use: Set environment variables (`LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=true` and `LANGCHAIN_API_KEY`), run your LLM code in Python/TypeScript, and view complete trace graphs on smith.langchain.com.
key_features: Full execution chain visual trace logging (spans, inputs, outputs, token costs)
Automated evaluation suites and LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks
Prompt Playground for testing prompt variations against production traces
Dataset curation tools for creating regression test suites

pricing.free_tier_details: Free Developer plan includes 5,000 trace spans per month for 1 user seat.

paid_plans.name: Plus
paid_plans.notes: Includes 50,000 trace spans/month, team collaboration, dataset sharing.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: VPC or self-hosted deployment, unlimited trace retention, SOC2 compliance.

name: Pinecone
tagline: Fully-managed serverless vector database engineered for ultra-low latency RAG search.
definition: Pinecone is a cloud-native vector database optimized for storing, indexing, and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings. It powers Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, recommendation systems, and long-term memory for AI agents.
why_it_matters: Pinecone popularized fully managed serverless vector search, allowing AI developers to query billions of vector embeddings with millisecond latency without managing index scaling or infrastructure shards.
workplace_use_cases: Storing document vector embeddings for enterprise RAG knowledge base search
Powering long-term memory retrieval for conversational AI agents
Building real-time e-commerce product recommendation engines
Executing hybrid keyword and semantic vector queries with metadata filtering
how_to_use: Create an index at pinecone.io, initialize the Pinecone SDK in Python/Node.js, upsert vector embeddings with metadata, and execute similarity queries using `index.query()`.
key_features: Serverless vector architecture with pay-per-query consumption pricing
Sub-100 millisecond vector search latency at scale
Metadata filtering for combining structured database attributes with semantic vectors
Integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, and AWS

pricing.free_tier_details: Free starter index with 2GB storage (~100k 1536-dim vectors).

paid_plans.name: Serverless Pay-As-You-Go
paid_plans.notes: Scales automatically to zero when idle with zero fixed monthly server fees.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Dedicated compute clusters, SOC2 Type II, HIPAA compliance, SAML SSO.

name: Weaviate
tagline: Open-source multi-modal vector database featuring native vectorization and hybrid search.
definition: Weaviate is an open-source vector database capable of storing both objects and vector embeddings. It supports hybrid search (combining sparse keyword search with dense vector similarity), native model vectorization, and multi-modal media indexing.
why_it_matters: Weaviate provides developers with the flexibility of self-hosting an enterprise-grade vector database or utilizing cloud hosting, making it a cornerstone for privacy-sensitive RAG architectures.
workplace_use_cases: Self-hosting vector storage for private enterprise medical and financial RAG apps
Combining BM25 keyword search with dense vector embeddings for hybrid retrieval
Indexing multi-modal data (images, text, audio) within a unified database schema
Running local vector search pipelines using Docker containers
how_to_use: Run Weaviate via Docker (`docker run -p 8080:8080 semitechnologies/weaviate`) or create a cluster on Weaviate Cloud Services (WCS), then connect via Python/Go/JS client libraries.
key_features: Open-source core engine with local Docker/Kubernetes deployment capability
Hybrid Search engine combining BM25 keyword matching and dense vector search
Native module integration for automated vectorization (OpenAI, HuggingFace, Cohere)
Multi-modal embedding support (text, image, audio)

pricing.free_tier_details: Open-source engine is free forever to self-host. Free 14-day cloud trial.

paid_plans.name: Weaviate Cloud (Serverless)
paid_plans.price: Starting at $0.085 per 1M vector dimensions / month
paid_plans.notes: Pay-per-use managed cloud hosting with zero infrastructure management.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Dedicated
paid_plans.notes: Dedicated cloud clusters or self-hosted enterprise support SLA.

name: Weights & Biases
tagline: Developer platform for MLOps, model training tracking, dataset versioning, and LLM evaluation.
definition: Weights & Biases (W&B) is an MLOps platform that provides experiment tracking, dataset versioning, model evaluation, and LLM fine-tuning monitoring for AI developers.
why_it_matters: W&B is the industry-standard experiment tracking framework relied upon by top AI labs (OpenAI, Meta) during foundation model training.
workplace_use_cases: Tracking loss curves, GPU memory usage, and hyperparameters during LLM fine-tuning
Versioning training datasets and model weights across team runs
Evaluating LLM prompt responses against golden benchmark datasets
how_to_use: Install `wandb` via pip, add `wandb.init()` to your Python training script, and view live training loss metrics on your dashboard.
key_features: Experiment tracking for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face
Dataset and model artifact version control
W&B Prompts for LLM trace evaluation

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan for individuals with 100GB artifact storage.

paid_plans.name: Team
paid_plans.notes: Shared project dashboards, team access controls.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Dedicated VPC/on-prem deployment, custom SLAs, SOC2 compliance.

name: Hugging Face
tagline: The central open-source community platform for hosting machine learning models, datasets, and AI apps.
definition: Hugging Face is the leading open-source machine learning platform and model repository, hosting over 500,000 open-weights AI models, datasets, and interactive Spaces (Gradio apps).
why_it_matters: Hugging Face is the 'GitHub of AI', serving as the indispensable global repository for downloading open-source model weights (Llama, DeepSeek, Whisper).
workplace_use_cases: Downloading open-weights AI models for local deployment or fine-tuning
Hosting interactive Gradio/Streamlit AI app demos via Hugging Face Spaces
Accessing open-source research datasets
how_to_use: Browse huggingface.co, install the `transformers` Python library, and load models with `from_pretrained()`.
key_features: 500,000+ open-source ML models and datasets
Hugging Face Spaces for hosting interactive web demos
Inference Endpoints for managed cloud model deployment

pricing.free_tier_details: Free access to model hub, open datasets, and basic Spaces.

paid_plans.name: Pro Account
paid_plans.notes: Higher compute hardware for Spaces, priority support.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Hub
paid_plans.notes: Organization-wide private model repositories and SSO.

name: Ollama
tagline: Open-source tool for running large language models locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
definition: Ollama is an open-source application that allows developers to run, manage, and query large language models (Llama 3, DeepSeek, Mistral) locally on their computers.
why_it_matters: Ollama made running local open-weights LLMs effortless, providing a simple Docker-like CLI command (`ollama run llama3`).
workplace_use_cases: Running 100% private, offline LLM inference on local Mac/PC hardware
Connecting local LLMs to VS Code extensions (Continue, Cursor) for air-gapped coding
Testing open-source model weights locally before cloud deployment
how_to_use: Download Ollama, open your terminal, run `ollama run llama3`, and chat locally.
key_features: Simple terminal CLI for model downloading and execution
Built-in local REST API compatible with OpenAI endpoint format
Supports Llama 3, DeepSeek-R1, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi

name: Groq LPU
tagline: Ultra-high-speed AI inference engine powered by custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware.
definition: Groq is an AI hardware and cloud inference company that utilizes custom Language Processing Unit (LPU) chips to run open LLMs (Llama 3, DeepSeek) at blazing speeds (500+ tokens/second).
why_it_matters: Groq shattered AI inference latency records, enabling real-time voice and conversational search applications.
workplace_use_cases: Deploying real-time voice and chat applications requiring near-instant response latency
Running high-throughput API inference for open-source models at low cost
Powering real-time streaming LLM applications
how_to_use: Get an API key at groq.com, replace your OpenAI base URL with Groq's endpoint in your code, and run instant inference.
key_features: Ultra-fast 500+ tokens/second LLM generation speed
Custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) chip architecture
OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy drop-in replacement

pricing.free_tier_details: Free Developer tier with generous rate limits for testing.

paid_plans.name: Pay-As-You-Go API
paid_plans.notes: Charged per million tokens depending on model size.

name: Cohere
tagline: Enterprise AI platform specializing in multilingual embeddings, reranking, and enterprise search.
definition: Cohere is an enterprise AI platform providing high-performance models for multilingual vector embeddings, RAG search reranking (Rerank 3), and domain-specific text generation.
why_it_matters: Cohere stands out in enterprise search by offering the industry's leading Rerank model, vastly improving RAG retrieval accuracy.
workplace_use_cases: Reranking vector search results in enterprise RAG applications to improve relevance
Generating multilingual vector embeddings across 100+ languages
Deploying enterprise-grade LLMs on private cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure)
how_to_use: Get an API key at cohere.com, install `cohere` Python package, and query Cohere models.
key_features: Cohere Rerank 3 model for boosting RAG search accuracy
Embed v3 multilingual vector embedding models
Deployable on AWS SageMaker, Azure, and private VPCs

pricing.free_tier_details: Free Developer plan for non-production testing.

paid_plans.name: Production API
paid_plans.notes: Usage-based pricing for Command, Embed, and Rerank models.

name: vLLM
tagline: High-throughput and memory-efficient open-source LLM serving engine powered by PagedAttention.
definition: vLLM is an open-source, high-throughput LLM serving engine developed at UC Berkeley. It utilizes PagedAttention memory management to serve open models at maximum throughput.
why_it_matters: vLLM became the standard self-hosted inference engine for serving open-weights LLMs in production environments.
workplace_use_cases: Self-hosting production LLM API infrastructure with high concurrency
Serving open-source models (DeepSeek, Llama 3) on private GPU clusters
Maximizing GPU memory utilization during batch inference
how_to_use: Install via `pip install vllm` and launch the OpenAI-compatible server using `python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server`.
key_features: PagedAttention algorithm for optimized KV cache memory management
OpenAI-compatible API server endpoint
Supports continuous batching and multi-GPU tensor parallelism
